# [TASK] Frontend: render inline query highlights in the search field

## Task
Render the span breakdown as inline highlights in the MUI search TextField.

## Scope
Visual rendering only, consumes #208's live parse results.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Connectors, negations, and entities are each visually distinct, not color alone (`QueryHighlightOverlay.test.jsx`'s per-category underline tests and "renders three categories in one query with three distinct underline styles" test)
- [x] Highlighting overlay stays correctly positioned/scrolled as the user types past the field's visible width (`Search.test.jsx`'s "positions the overlay over the real input's measured box" and "mirrors the real input's horizontal scroll onto the overlay" tests)
- [x] A short legend or tooltip explains what each highlight style means, discoverable without documentation (`HighlightLegend.test.jsx`'s focusable-button and keyboard-focus-tooltip tests)
- [x] Works with the MUI TextField's existing styling (`useStyles`) without breaking its current layout/theme (`Search.test.jsx`'s "shows the legend and overlay, and hides the real input's own text, once a query is typed" test — the real `<input>` keeps its MUI classes, only `color` goes transparent)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
A native `<input>` can't style a substring, so the visible text is an absolutely-positioned, `aria-hidden` overlay (`QueryHighlightOverlay`) drawn over a transparent input, with the caret kept visible. `Search.jsx` keeps the overlay aligned using `getBoundingClientRect` in `useLayoutEffect`, re-syncing on window resize, a `ResizeObserver` on the field wrapper, and the input's horizontal scroll.

Category styles and the legend both derive from one shared list (`highlightCategories.js`) so they can't drift apart: connector dotted, negation bold wavy, entity solid.

New files: `QueryHighlightOverlay.jsx`, `HighlightLegend.jsx`, `highlightCategories.js`, `highlightStyles.js`.
